mechanism: Baclofen is a CNS depressant (GABA-B agonist) while modafinil is a CNS stimulant, creating opposing pharmacodynamic effects that may reduce efficacy of both agents and increase unpredictable CNS effects.
action: Monitor patients for reduced efficacy of either agent; consider dose adjustment or alternative therapy if CNS effects become problematic; counsel on avoiding alcohol and other CNS depressants.
